what: LAX-32 turns the FM-1 into a multitimbral LA-style sound module after the 1987 Roland MT-32: 8 parts plus rhythm on MIDI, 128 sounds in MT-32 order, 30 drums, 32 partials, reverb and a 20-character LCD. Adds an arpeggiator and a 6-track, 64-step sequencer modelled on Skiff's. No Roland ROM used.
author: Philippe Jaccoud
